repeating_carbine.name: Repeating Carbine
repeating_carbine.desc: Ballistics, tier 3 schematic. Clockwork drum, rifled barrel, walnut stock. Jams more often where magic runs thick.

boiler_lance.name: Boiler Lance
boiler_lance.desc: Steamworks, tier 2 schematic. A pocket boiler drives the head forward. Overcharge it for a huge hit, and pray the boiler holds.

fen_hookblade.name: Fen Hookblade
fen_hookblade.desc: Smithing, common Fenfolk pattern. The hook can trip a target, costing them 2 AP. Works the same anywhere, magic or not.

shelf_longbow.name: Shelf Longbow
shelf_longbow.desc: Fletching, Freeholder design. Yew and ash, horn nocks. Quiet and reliable.

starglass_staff.name: Starglass Staff
starglass_staff.desc: Foci, Collegium formula. Adds +2 spell power. Glows brighter at high Resonance. In a factory district it is just a stick.

frostvein_dagger.name: Frostvein Dagger
frostvein_dagger.unidentified_name: A dagger, cold to the touch
frostvein_dagger.desc: Ossuan work. An ice blade that never melts: +1d6 cold that scales with Resonance, and a critical hit slows the target (3 AP).

healing_draught.name: Healing Draught
healing_draught.desc: Restores 2d4+2 HP. Costs 2 AP in combat.

assayer_lens.name: Assayer's Lens
assayer_lens.desc: Identifies one unknown item in the user's pack, or the party's.

coin.name: Coin
coin.desc: Combine scrip and old Compact silver, both spend the same here.
